description: OpenSSH — secure connections, keys, file copy and tunnels.

ssh-connect.title: Connect to a host
ssh-connect.description: Opens a remote shell session authenticated over SSH.
arguments: Verbose mode to debug the connection.

ssh-port.title: Connect on a specific port
ssh-port.description: Connects when the SSH server listens on a port other than 22.

ssh-identity.title: Use a specific key
ssh-identity.description: Specifies the private key file used to authenticate.
warnings: The private key must have 600 permissions (chmod 600) or SSH rejects it.

ssh-jump.title: Jump host (ProxyJump)
ssh-jump.description: Connects to an internal host through a bastion/jump host in a single line.

ssh-keygen.title: Generate key pair
ssh-keygen.description: Creates a public/private key pair. ed25519 is the recommended algorithm.
warnings: Protect the private key with a passphrase; never share it.

ssh-copy-id.title: Install key on the server
ssh-copy-id.description: Copies your public key to the server's authorized_keys, enabling passwordless login.

ssh-add.title: Add key to the agent
ssh-add.description: Loads the private key into ssh-agent so you don't type the passphrase on every connection.
examples: Lists the keys loaded in the agent.
arguments: Removes all identities from the agent.

ssh-agent.title: Start the agent
ssh-agent.description: Starts ssh-agent in the current session to manage keys in memory.

scp.title: Copy file (scp)
scp.description: Copies files between local and remote machines over SSH.
examples: Downloads a remote file to the current directory.

rsync-ssh.title: Sync (rsync)
rsync-ssh.description: Incrementally syncs directories over SSH, transferring only the differences.
examples: Mirrors the source, removing at the destination whatever no longer exists at the source.
arguments: Removes files at the destination that are missing from the source.
warnings: --delete removes files at the destination; test first with --dry-run.

sftp.title: SFTP session
sftp.description: Opens an interactive file transfer session over SSH (get/put/ls).

ssh-local-tunnel.title: Local tunnel (-L)
ssh-local-tunnel.description: Forwards a local port to a service reachable from the remote host (e.g. a database).
warnings: Expose sensitive ports only on localhost, never on 0.0.0.0.

ssh-remote-tunnel.title: Reverse tunnel (-R)
ssh-remote-tunnel.description: Exposes a local service on a port of the remote host (reverse tunnel).
warnings: Be careful when exposing internal services on public servers.

ssh-dynamic-tunnel.title: SOCKS proxy (-D)
ssh-dynamic-tunnel.description: Creates a dynamic SOCKS proxy, routing application traffic through the remote host.
examples: Starts the proxy in the background, without opening a shell.
arguments: Doesn't run a remote command (tunnel only).

ssh-config.title: ~/.ssh/config file
ssh-config.description: Defines per-host aliases and options, allowing 'ssh prod' instead of a long command line.

ssh-known-hosts-remove.title: Remove known host
ssh-known-hosts-remove.description: Removes a host's key from known_hosts (after a server reinstall/key change).
arguments: Removes the host's entries from known_hosts.
warnings: Only remove it if you trust the server's key change; otherwise it may indicate a MITM attack.

ssh-keyscan.title: Collect host key
ssh-keyscan.description: Fetches a host's public key and adds it to known_hosts (useful in automation).
arguments: Hashes the host names in the file.
warnings: Verify the fingerprint over a trusted channel before trusting the key.
